payload.author: claude
payload.body: Progress: web-push adapter (commit 6c8db26) + push delivery boot-wiring (FR-265, ee027ab) + docs cleanup all DONE. REMAINING on this umbrella: (1) OTel export + FRICK_OTEL_* config parsing (observability; deps fetchable, the actual OTLP export needs a collector to verify); (2) outbound email — DEFERRED, no consumer yet (password-reset routes are unported, so an EmailAdapter would be dead code); (3) custom search adapter — a larger store-entangled story (FTS indexing on object writes + a query route; the inspect search route is already stubbed pending it). Recommend splitting these into discrete tickets.
